author: Bellular News
description:
DLSS 5 has escaped Nvidia's carefully controlled demos, and people are now jamming it into anything they can. Some still images look impressive. Once the characters move, the lighting and animation stop belonging to the same face. It can cut the frame rate in half too. I can see what Nvidia is building here. Right now, it asks players to accept a lot of weirdness for an effect most PCs can't run well.
